summary: Tower built 1953 by H.W. Sayers on the Sayersbrook Bison Ranch near Potosi, Washington County; ranch sold at auction in 2015; site is private and its current condition is not described.

access.note: The Central US Lookouts page lists the site as private.

notes_for_editor: Current condition of the tower is not described in any source found; facts omit status on purpose. The site is private, so the story now says the page lists it as private and advises not going onto it without the owner's permission; that advice is not attributed to the source. H.W. Sayers (1953 tower) and Herb Sayers (named in the ranch history as a 1940s owner, Skip's father) may be the same man, but no source says so, so the story does not link them. The May 2015 result rests on the Central US Lookouts page only (its 'May 2015' heading is now quoted as evidence); the PRWeb item announces the auction and does not report a result. The ranch website still sells bison meat, but it does not say who owns the land now. Blocked: bizjournals 2015 article (403), landandfarm auction listing (403), lasr.net review (403). Brief agency 'Private' confirmed; county confirmed. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the 1970s bison start is attributed to Skip and Connie, as the ranch history states, not to 'the family'.
